Title: General availability: Zend Z-Ray for Azure app service

Body.Content: The Zend Z-Ray for Azure app service is now generally available. It gives developers insight into entire PHP applications, including execution time, exceptions and errors, and SQL queries used. With Zend’s gallery of plug-ins, developers can use Zend Z-Ray to see how every line of code is performing as it’s executing, whether it’s a Magento event, a Drupal module, a WordPress plug-in, or a PHP framework function. Zend Z-Ray is integrated with the app management experience. It is easy to enable through the Settings blade of the Azure portal. To see Zend Z-Ray for Azure in action, watch this quick video Introducing Z-Ray on Azure.

The Zend Z-Ray for Azure app service is now generally available. It gives developers insight into entire PHP applications, including execution time, exceptions and errors, and SQL queries used. With Zend’s gallery of plug-ins, developers can use Zend Z-Ray to see how every line of code is performing as it’s executing, whether it’s a Magento event, a Drupal module, a WordPress plug-in, or a PHP framework function.

Zend Z-Ray is integrated with the app management experience. It is easy to enable through the Settings blade of the Azure portal .

To see Zend Z-Ray for Azure in action, watch this quick video Introducing Z-Ray on Azure .
